Definition
[Coercivity condition] 1. ch8:8.2.1-def-1\group Existence of Minimizers We say the Lagrangian $L$ satisfies the coercivity condition (for the exponent $q$ of (3)) if \[ \begin{cases} \text{there exist constants } \alpha > 0, \beta \geq 0 \text{ such that} \\ L(p, z, x) \geq \alpha |p|^q - \beta \\ \text{for all } p \in \R ^n, z \in \R , x \in U. \end{cases} \tag {4} \]
